findings.claim: Signed favorable-minus-comparison endpoint contrasts are strongest and most reproducible for the short-range pair kernels: pair_kernel_1.5 (integrated z 0.562, q 1.5e-4, positive batch fraction 1.0), pair_kernel_2.5 (0.631, q 2.2e-5, 1.0), pair_kernel_3.5 (0.540, q 9.8e-5, 1.0) and pair_kernel_5.0 (0.319, q 3.7e-3, 0.857), while pair_kernel_7.0 is negative (-0.485, q 1.5e-4, 0.0). The same ordering appears in the branch-adjusted raw and adjusted correlations (e.g. pair_kernel_1.5 r=0.085 raw / 0.101 adjusted; pair_kernel_2.5 r=0.088 / 0.084; pair_kernel_7.0 r=-0.055 / -0.050). These are selection-enrichment contrasts on a radial pair-distance shell density, not absolute geometric quality or interaction energies.

Landmark softmin and occupancy contrasts are signed and landmark-specific rather than a single global direction: landmark_00_softmin is negative (-0.481, q 8.1e-4, 0.0 positive batches) with landmark_00_occupancy3 positive (0.545, q 2.4e-4, 1.0); landmark_06_softmin is positive (0.294, q 6.8e-4, 1.0) with landmark_06_occupancy3/occupancy5 negative (-0.0087/-0.365, q 8.1e-4/6.8e-4, 0.0); landmark_18_softmin positive (0.264, q 6.0e-3, 0.857) with landmark_18_occupancy5 negative (-0.311, q 3.8e-3, 0.143). The branch-adjusted correlations reproduce the same sign pattern (e.g. landmark_06_occupancy3 r=-0.068 raw / -0.066 adjusted; landmark_18_occupancy5 r=-0.073 / -0.076). Softmin is a normalized soft-minimum distance and occupancy is a radial shell density, so these are enrichment contrasts, not absolute geometric descriptors.

Global shape contrasts are weak-to-moderate and mostly negative: shape_yy is the most reproducible (integrated z -0.513, q 1.5e-5, positive batch fraction 0.0; raw correlation -0.103, adjusted -0.100), shape_xx is -0.495 (q 8.1e-4, 0.071), shape_yz -0.212 (q 0.035, 0.214) and shape_zz -0.183 (q 0.067, 0.286). Global centroid contrasts are near-null (global_centroid_x -0.111, q 0.257; global_centroid_y -0.243, q 0.014; global_centroid_z -0.061, q 0.481). These are coordinate covariance descriptors in A^2, not physical interaction energies or evidence of a neural-module mechanism.

Joint-motion diagnostics are the most consistent negative signals: joint_innovation_RMS_A (raw z -5.15e-5, q 0.038, 0.857 same-sign batches; adjusted -3.60e-5, q 0.020, 0.929), joint_internal_RMS_A (raw -5.00e-5, q 0.044, 0.786; adjusted -3.42e-5, q 0.030, 0.929) and joint_translation_RMS_A (raw -1.10e-5, q 0.095, 0.714; adjusted -8.99e-6, q 0.072, 0.714). The corresponding correlations are the largest in the table (joint_innovation_RMS_A r=-0.142 raw / -0.150 adjusted; joint_internal_RMS_A r=-0.130 / -0.137). These are adjusted joint diagnostics, so they indicate that coherent joint motion carries information beyond isolated marginal descriptors; they are not rigid-motion residuals of the region moments themselves.

Within-selector joint diagnostics show that selection innovation is positively associated with native alignment (0.092, q 2.2e-9, positive batch fraction 1.0) and with teacher innovation-contrast alignment (0.226, q 2.2e-9, 1.0), but negatively associated with observed child score gain (-0.036, q 1.8e-7, 0.0). Teacher contrast is dominated by its internal fraction (0.787) with smaller translation (0.132) and rotation (0.081) fractions, and atom participation is 0.384. These are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit, not causal selection effects.

The supplied continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations over the complete observed support [0.0, 0.49] with extrapolation disallowed, and they are not constant: landmark_00_soft_mass has first_rate_z 9.27 and last_rate_z -10.00 with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict; landmark_00_local_dx has first_rate_z -17.49 and last_rate_z 8.11 with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; landmark_00_local_cxy has first_rate_z 64.83 and last_rate_z -19.67 with 9 sign changes and 14 strong sign conflicts. Relative node RMSE ranges from about 0.29 to 0.99, and no polynomial fit is accepted (polynomial_accepted false throughout). A time-conditioned rule is therefore better supported than a constant rule, but the contrast curve is not an absolute reward target.

The curve-fidelity audit selects 24 of the supplied curves under the rule relative_rmse_le 0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0, quiet_node_large_fit_fraction_le 0.1, absolute_integrated_z_ge 0.1, batch_direction_fraction_ge 0.857 and q_lt 0.05. The selected set includes pair_kernel_1.5, pair_kernel_2.5, pair_kernel_3.5, shape_xx and shape_yy, but the audit also records last empirical versus last fit z disagreements (e.g. landmark_00_softmin last_empirical_z -0.146 versus last_fit_z -0.481; landmark_02_occupancy5 0.142 versus -0.323) and quiet-node large-fit fractions up to 0.34 for pair_kernel_5.0. Legendre runtime use is disallowed for every audited curve.

Descendant survival credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity. The survival enrichment contrasts are mostly weak and null (e.g. landmark_00_soft_mass 0.365, q 0.120; landmark_02_local_dz 0.206, q 0.356; landmark_04_local_czz 0.266, q 0.302; landmark_07_soft_mass 0.220, q 0.356; landmark_10_soft_mass 0.234, q 0.302; landmark_18_local_czz 0.217, q 0.302), while the survival change-rate contrasts are larger but mostly non-significant after multiplicity adjustment (landmark_04_local_cyz 1.791, q 0.302; landmark_19_local_dz 1.258, q 0.538; landmark_01_local_dz 1.231, q 0.528; landmark_02_local_cxx 1.200, q 0.538; landmark_04_local_dz 1.254, q 0.570; landmark_19_local_czz 1.258, q 0.538). Because decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, last-record credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.

Parent-child increment contrasts disagree with the whole-window endpoint contrasts in several places: shape_xx increment rate z is -3.70 (q 0.095, 0.214 positive batches) and shape_yy -3.85 (q 0.161, 0.143), consistent in sign with the endpoint shape contrasts; but shape_xz is +3.00 (q 0.207, 0.714), pair_kernel_2.5 +3.96 (q 0.208, 0.643), pair_kernel_7.0 -3.14 (q 0.208, 0.357), landmark_00_softmin -4.91 (q 0.046, 0.071), landmark_00_occupancy3 +4.28 (q 0.081, 0.857), landmark_03_occupancy5 -3.02 (q 0.161, 0.286) and landmark_13_occupancy5 +2.48 (q 0.279, 0.714). The increment contrasts are within-path change measures and are not the same quantity as the population endpoint contrasts.

Turnover accounting separates population rate, parent-edge rate and turnover residual. For landmark_00_soft_mass the population rate is 0.185 (p 0.723), the edge rate 4.545 (p 0.034) and the residual -4.360 (p 0.034); for landmark_00_local_cxx the population rate is -0.058 (p 0.861), edge rate -4.343 (p 0.004) and residual 4.286 (p 0.002); for landmark_01_local_cyy population 1.026 (p 0.061), edge -5.371 (p 0.001) and residual 6.397 (p 4.3e-4); for landmark_04_local_cxx population 1.075 (p 0.095), edge -4.596 (p 1.7e-4) and residual 5.671 (p 2.5e-5); for landmark_07_local_cxx population 0.385 (p 0.300), edge -4.691 (p 3.0e-4) and residual 5.076 (p 1.1e-4); for landmark_16_local_cyy population 0.465 (p 0.292), edge -5.903 (p 5.9e-4) and residual 6.367 (p 1.2e-4); for landmark_19_local_cxx population 0.477 (p 0.284), edge -4.822 (p 2.2e-4) and residual 5.298 (p 2.3e-4); for landmark_19_local_cyy population 0.983 (p 0.243), edge -4.385 (p 0.005) and residual 5.368 (p 0.001). The residual is an accounting diagnostic that includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

The information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A 0.081 (CI 0.070-0.092), compressed_choice_fixed_RMS_A 0.564 (CI 0.499-0.620), compressed_choice_proper_rigid_RMS_A 0.529 (CI 0.468-0.582), top4_teacher_overlap 0.470 (CI 0.427-0.515), compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation 0.102 (CI 0.065-0.140) and full_chosen_teacher_score_correlation 0.064 (CI 0.021-0.103), with 14 independent batches and leave-one-batch exclusion. The audit states that the nonnegative excess distance is by construction and not a causal affinity effect, that proper rigid alignment retains fixed Hungarian correspondence rather than a globally solved rotation/permutation distance, and that teacher score correlations are observational and not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor. The joint diagnostics likewise report teacher_contrast_coherence 0.812, teacher_control_root_ESS 1.297, teacher_score_gap 0.172, teacher_noise_RMS_A 0.067, teacher_lower_rejected_fraction 0.326, teacher_expected_probability_advantage 0.0070, teacher_sign_calibration_cosine 0.973, teacher_contrast_translation_fraction 0.132 and teacher_contrast_rotation_fraction 0.081.

The lineage support table records 14 complete-survival batches, 700 total batch nodes, 349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 with fewer than 6 ancestors, teacher counts per node ranging from 17 to 28, and terminal metadata with terminal_index 99, terminal_score_time 0.99 and terminal_state_time 1.0 for every batch. The learning window is [0.0, 0.5] with observed score times 0.0 to 0.49, curve support [0.0, 0.49], and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable. The teacher modes table reports 28 teachers, assignment RMS quantiles [0.446, 0.863, 1.050] A, and temperature_edits false. The incumbent fixes mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0, and the allowed edits are pointcloud_delta_A in {0.5, 1.0, 2.0}, an evidence-bound landmark region index, teacher_neighbors in {2, 4, 8}, an evidence-bound temporal region index with verified continuous salience, and temporal_teacher_blend in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}.

hypotheses.claim: A testable coordinate intervention is to raise the weight on short-range pair-kernel observables (pair_kernel_1.5, 2.5, 3.5) and lower it on pair_kernel_7.0, using the endpoint pointcloud reward with the declared detached matching convention. Observable: favorable-minus-comparison pair-kernel shell density. Intended response: increased short-range shell density and decreased long-range shell density at the observed selection nodes. Target origin: the supplied endpoint contrasts and their branch-adjusted correlations. Spatial scale: pair distances 1.5-3.5 A versus 7.0 A. Discriminating failure condition: if the short-range contrasts do not reproduce across independent batches or if the long-range contrast changes sign, the direction is not supported. This remains a measurable contrast, not an absolute reward target.

A landmark-specific intervention is to increase occupancy3 at landmark_00 and landmark_06 while decreasing occupancy5 at landmark_06 and landmark_18, and to decrease softmin at landmark_00 while increasing softmin at landmark_06 and landmark_18. Observable: landmark softmin distance and occupancy3/occupancy5 shell densities. Intended response: closer soft-minimum distance at landmark_00 and denser inner shells at landmark_00 and landmark_06. Target origin: the signed landmark contrasts and their branch-adjusted correlations. Spatial scale: 3 A and 5 A shells with sigma 1.0 A around the named landmarks. Discriminating failure condition: if the landmark-specific signs do not hold across independent batches, or if the occupancy and softmin contrasts conflict at the same landmark, the direction is not supported.

A testable joint-motion intervention is to reduce joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A while preserving the native rigid pose, since these are the most consistent negative adjusted signals and the joint diagnostics show positive association between selection innovation and native alignment. Observable: adjusted joint innovation and internal RMS in A. Intended response: lower joint innovation and internal RMS at the observed selection nodes. Target origin: the branch-adjusted joint diagnostics. Spatial scale: whole-endpoint joint motion. Discriminating failure condition: if the joint RMS contrasts do not reproduce across independent batches, or if reducing them degrades the observed child score gain association, the direction is not supported.

A testable temporal intervention is to use the temporal_teacher_blend recipe with a validated absolute contrast change at actual score nodes, rather than a constant rule, because the observed-node linear contrasts show sign changes and rate changes across the complete observed support. Observable: the validated absolute contrast change at actual score nodes. Intended response: regional attention that follows the observed contrast changes within the observed window. Target origin: the supplied continuous contrast functions and the curve-fidelity audit. Temporal scale: the observed support [0.0, 0.49] only, with no extrapolation and no arbitrary time bins. Discriminating failure condition: if the contrast curve does not reproduce across independent batches, or if the blend does not improve the endpoint contrast relative to the static teacher, the direction is not supported.

A testable accounting intervention is to compare within-path change against changing cohort composition by tracking the parent-edge rate and the turnover residual separately for the same observables. Observable: population rate, parent-edge rate and turnover residual. Intended response: a decision on whether the supported finding is within-path change or changing cohort composition. Target origin: the increment contrasts and the turnover accounting table. Temporal scale: the complete observed window. Discriminating failure condition: if the residual is dominated by score reclassification or extant-parent weighting rather than resampling, the within-path interpretation is not supported. The residual is an accounting diagnostic, not a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

A testable coverage intervention is to restrict any coordinate rule to observables with adequate ancestral coverage and independent-batch agreement, because 349 nodes have fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 have fewer than 6, and because the information audit reports only moderate teacher overlap and weak chosen-teacher score correlation. Observable: ancestral coverage per node and independent-batch agreement. Intended response: a coordinate rule that is reproducible across the 14 independent batches. Target origin: the lineage support table and the information audit. Spatial scale: the observed selection nodes. Discriminating failure condition: if the rule is driven by nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors or by a single batch, the direction is not supported.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects are retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters and no temperature edit is proposed.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; moment effects, pair kernels and turnover rates are diagnostic evidence only.
